# signal-desktop-fedora

> Fedora RPM packaging and build automation for Signal Desktop.

The repository contains a Fedora SPEC file and supporting scripts and GitHub Actions workflows for building Signal Desktop RPMs, with Copr used as an external build service.

## Repository overview

- [Source repository](https://github.com/useidel/signal-desktop-fedora): Canonical GitHub repository, including source files, issues, history, and repository metadata.
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/useidel/signal-desktop-fedora/HEAD/README.md): Primary project documentation and usage notes.

## Topics

- Fedora/RPM packaging
- Signal Desktop
- GitHub Actions
- Copr
